content.user_title: Build a Remotion video SaaS application
content.value_statement: Building a video SaaS application requires choices about UI previews, rendering, and deployment. This skill gives focused Remotion guidance for those choices and links to the relevant documentation.
actual_capabilities: Compare framework and template options for a Remotion SaaS application.
Explain how to embed the Remotion Player in a React application.
Recommend client-side or server-side rendering approaches.
Guide a high-level Remotion Lambda setup without requesting credentials.
Identify deployment considerations for Node.js, Vercel, Azure, and Cloudflare.
Highlight production concerns such as authentication, rate limiting, and render cleanup.
limitations: It provides guidance and documentation links, not a complete application implementation.
It does not create cloud accounts, IAM policies, or deploy infrastructure automatically.
It does not accept, inspect, or store AWS credentials.
It focuses on Remotion SaaS workflows rather than general video production.

use_cases.title: Choose a rendering architecture
use_cases.description: Compare browser, Node.js, and cloud rendering options for a new video product.

use_cases.title: Add an in-app video preview
use_cases.description: Plan how to embed a Remotion Player preview in an existing React interface.

use_cases.title: Prepare a production render service
use_cases.description: Create a checklist for secure rendering, progress reporting, cleanup, and cost controls.

prompt_templates.title: Start a video application
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a Remotion SaaS template for a simple video generation application.

prompt_templates.title: Embed a preview
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how I should use the Remotion Player to preview a composition in my React application.

prompt_templates.title: Select a renderer
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare client-side rendering, Node.js rendering, and Remotion Lambda for a multi-user video SaaS product.

prompt_templates.title: Plan secure production rendering
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production checklist for a Remotion Lambda render service with authentication, rate limits, privacy, cost controls, and progress updates.

output_examples.input: Which renderer should I use for a small internal video tool?
output: Recommended approach: start with local or Node.js rendering for controlled internal usage.
Consider Lambda when demand, scaling, or job isolation requires managed cloud rendering.
Next step: review the server-side rendering comparison documentation.

output_examples.input: What should I prepare before deploying Remotion Lambda?
output: Confirm your AWS account, region, and Remotion project.
Set up the required IAM resources through the documented flow.
Store credentials locally in environment variables and never share them in chat.
Plan authentication, rate limits, cleanup, privacy, and cost controls before production.

best_practices: Use the linked Remotion documentation as the source of truth for cloud setup steps.
Keep credentials in local environment variables and never paste them into chat.
Add authentication, rate limits, cleanup, and cost controls before serving public render requests.
anti_patterns: Do not use a production Lambda workflow without reviewing IAM permissions and quotas.
Do not expose unauthenticated render endpoints to the public internet.
Do not expect the skill to replace deployment testing or cloud provider configuration.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps plan Remotion-based video applications, including previews, rendering, and deployment choices.

faq.question: Can it build my complete SaaS application?
faq.answer: No. It provides targeted guidance and documentation links, but it does not generate a complete product by itself.

faq.question: Does it support React previews?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains when and how to use the Remotion Player in a React application.

faq.question: Can it help with AWS Lambda?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines the documented Lambda setup flow and production concerns.

faq.question: Will it request my AWS credentials?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly says not to paste secrets into chat.

faq.question: Which deployment platforms are covered?
faq.answer: It covers guidance for Node.js, AWS Lambda, Vercel, Azure Container Apps, Cloudflare Containers, and GitHub Actions.
